spec.description: Dashboard for displaying basic host metrics collected by telegraf and stored into the InfluxDB 2.X. Metrics are fetched by flux.

spec.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
|> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mem")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "total" or r["_field"] == "available")
|> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
|> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
|> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    _value: float(v: r.total - r.available) / float(v: r.total) * 100.0
}))

from(bucket: v.bucket)
|> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "win_system")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "System_Up_Time")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["objectname"] == "System")
|> last()

from(bucket: v.bucket)
|> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "win_cpu")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Percent_Idle_Time")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["objectname"] == "Processor")
|> last()
|> group()
|> mean()
|> map(fn: (r) => ({r: 100.00 - r._value}))

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "win_system")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Processes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>  r.host == "${host}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "win_system")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Threads")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>  r.host == "${host}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "win_cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Percent_Idle_Time")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["objectname"] == "Processor")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _field: "CPU usage",
      _value: 100.0 - r._value
  }))

from(bucket: v.bucket)
|> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "win_cpu")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Percent_DPC_Time" or r["_field"] == "Percent_Interrupt_Time" or r["_field"] == "Percent_Privileged_Time" or r["_field"] == "Percent_Processor_Time" or r["_field"] == "Percent_User_Time")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["objectname"] == "Processor")
|> group(columns: ["_field"])
|> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.bucket)
|> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "win_system")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Context_Switches_persec")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["objectname"] == "System")
|> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.bucket)
|> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "win_mem")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Available_Bytes")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["objectname"] == "Memory")
|> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.bucket)
|> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "win_disk")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Percent_Free_Space")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["instance"] =~ /${disk}/)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["objectname"] == "LogicalDisk")
|> last()
|> group()
|> mean()

from(bucket: v.bucket)
|> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "win_disk")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Disk_Read_Bytes_persec")

|> filter(fn: (r) => r["objectname"] == "LogicalDisk")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["instance"] =~ /${disk}/)

from(bucket: v.bucket)

|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "win_disk")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Disk_Write_Bytes_persec")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")

from(bucket: v.bucket)

|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Percent_Idle_Time")

|> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Percent_Disk_Read_Time" or r["_field"] == "Percent_Disk_Write_Time")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ThreadCount" or r._field == "PeakThreadCount")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "jvm_memory")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "HeapMemoryUsage.used" or r._field == "HeapMemoryUsage.max" or r._field == "HeapMemoryUsage.committed")

from(bucket: "telegraf")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "jvm_memory")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "HeapMemoryUsage.used" or r._field == "HeapMemoryUsage.max")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: r["HeapMemoryUsage.used"] / r["HeapMemoryUsage.max"] * 100.0,

from(bucket: "telegraf")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "CollectionTime")

  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)

from(bucket: "telegraf")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "usage_user")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["cpu"] == "cpu-total")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
